notes.content: The page presents six relations in implication diagram (1.18), initially classes four as orders and two as symmetric, and discusses reflexivity. A slanted authorial correction rejects incidence as an order on the whole family. Formula (1.19) characterizes self-parallelism by the empty figure. Remark a) describes recovery of incidence from order by strict irreducibles and (1.17), then recovery of the distinguished family, deployment and order from incidence through (1.21), (1.22) and the comma-numbered (1,23). The concluding sentence revises its wording toward the data fixing an atelier and continues off the sheet.
math_reading_decisions: All five double arrows point downward. The enclosure has two left-corner gaps and an upper-right overhang. The diagram compatibility sign has an additional upright of uncertain live/canceled state; both prose signs have only the opposed zigzags.

The marginal membership is ordinary in; the apparent upper prime belongs to the preceding slanted line. The proposed reflexive repair literally repeats F in every operand position, and no G is supplied.

Main performed a limited conditional check using the committed definition (1.17): if A triangleleft B means A≤B and A in M, and ≤ is an order, then incidence is transitive and F triangleleft F iff F in M. It is reflexive on M and on the entire family iff M is that family. Properness of M and the order axioms themselves were not established.

R3 and main checked that the literal F/F disjunction in the proposed repair is true on the diagonal because F=F. The displayed formula does not by itself specify a relation on unequal operands. This does not authorize a textual repair.

The final letter of (1.22) is visibly the family F with a closed returning foot. H’s explanatory note observes this literal form, while its display substitutes ordinary F. The transcription preserves the literal family letter.

Capital Sup, raised t in str^t., all i indices, the final X≤F_i and the open inclusion in (1,23) are preserved. H’s note about retracing of the final inequality in (1.20) is credited; no separate canceled predecessor is established.
No proof of the full implication diagram, self-parallelism criterion, strict-irreducibility reconstruction, deployment reconstruction or order/inclusion equivalence was performed.
